title: The Painted Letter
author: Ulyana Ishikawa
blurb: Bram Ishikawa, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
